findings.title: Bulk Delete has no confirmation modal
findings.where: Toolbar > Delete button when rows selected
findings.symptom: Click Delete → items immediately destroyed, no 'Are you sure?'.
findings.impact: Data loss in one click; misclick risk near the X button.
findings.repro: Select 3 rows → click Delete → notice they vanish without prompt.
findings.triage: Wire into a confirmation modal using the existing Dialog primitive.

findings.title: Filter pills have near-invisible active state
findings.symptom: Active pill is white-on-light; both options look identical.
findings.impact: Reader can't tell which filter is active without checking URL.
findings.repro: Toggle between Pending and All — notice the pill barely changes.
findings.triage: Stronger contrast on active (border or filled color).

findings.title: Console warns: Missing aria-describedby on Dialog
findings.impact: Screen readers won't announce dialog purpose properly.

positives: Deep linking works cleanly via URL params
notes: Side effect: 3 example items added then deleted during testing.
